description.en_US: Reply to messages right in the notification popup and the sidebar list. Turns on inline replies in the stock notification server and adds a reply field to notifications whose app offers one (androlink, KDE Connect and others); Enter sends, Esc cancels. The field appears only while the app can still receive the reply, the popup stays open while you type, and the reply text is never logged.
description.zh_TW: 直接在通知彈窗和側欄通知列表裡回覆訊息。這個模組會在 stock 通知伺服器開啟直接回覆，並在 App 提供回覆功能的通知（androlink、KDE Connect 等）加上回覆欄；Enter 送出，Esc 取消。只有 App 還能收到回覆時才會出現回覆欄，打字時彈窗不會自動消失，回覆內容不會寫進記錄。
description.zh_CN: 直接在通知弹窗和侧栏通知列表里回复消息。这个模块会在 stock 通知服务器开启直接回复，并在应用提供回复功能的通知（androlink、KDE Connect 等）加上回复栏；Enter 发送，Esc 取消。只有应用还能收到回复时才会出现回复栏，打字时弹窗不会自动消失，回复内容不会写进日志。

patches.content:
// inline_reply: advertise inline replies so apps send an inline-reply action
        inlineReplySupported: true

// inline_reply: a reply is being typed in this popup; keep it on screen
        property bool iimpReplyHold: false

// inline_reply: never time out a popup while its reply field is in use
        if (root.list.find((notif) => notif.notificationId === id)?.iimpReplyHold) return;

// inline_reply: notificationId whose popup reply field holds the keyboard (-1: none)
    property int iimpReplyComposer: -1
